base.subject: ops(stigmergy): Back to the Trickster deck keeps the open card where it sat
base.body:
ops(stigmergy): Back to the Trickster deck keeps the open card where it sat

Just before a deck switch or an entry jump pushes its history step,
url-nav announces the leave (nav:leave), and the deck writes its view onto
its own history entry: the open cards, the collapse, the search and
filters, and the card last clicked with its distance from the top of the
window. A Back onto that entry starts the deck from that view and puts the
card back where it sat, focused. Entering by tab or t pushes a fresh entry
with no view, so it still starts collapsed and unfiltered.

branch.body:
deposit(D-2026-11-04-AUDILLUSIONS): Auditory Illusions minted: the ear climbed stage by stage, each illusion with its twin in the eye; closes the Shepard ghost

Mint: Auditory Illusions, a concept at the root (creation, tools, philosophy; sprout, offered), with its Context in the bundle. Closes the [[Auditory Illusions]] ghost in Shepard Tone Synthesizer Open Question 6, which the 2026-10-24 Weave ruled an invitation.

Map as shown to Loudon: links emerged-from Shepard Tone Synthesizer (the-barber-pole-question), connects-to Frequency-Time Duality (risset-on-the-duality-axis), connects-to Boundary-Crossing Instruments (thresholds-the-ear-draws), connects-to Sidechain ↔ Conversation (masking-heard), mirrors Whisper (phantom-words). No hero yet; rich face to go to Enrichment as a commissioning baton. Loudon changed the title from the working name Sonic Hallucinations ("Auditory illusions is good for me, lets use that name"). The length tension (about 3,300 words against sprout 150-400) was named to him, and the explanations were kept.

Parked on a branch under Deposit step 6: the words wait for Loudon to read them whole, and for a cold read by a fresh palace-reader, since the Concierge shaped the map. Lints run in the worktree: doc-drift, ghost-links, bundle-hygiene and entry-naming show nothing against the new files; link-directions on a fresh temp build, no errors; the Shepard ghost no longer reports.

Deposit Ceremony v2.9.

branch.body:
deposit(D-2026-11-04-AUDILLUSIONS): cold-read fixes: twins regraded where the mechanism was a shape, dates and credits made exact, the guesses marked as guesses, Whisper a cousin of phantom words

Amends 4bee43f9 and c5dc144a on the cold reader's "pass with fixes", relayed by the working session; Loudon has not yet read these words, and the rewritten sentences go to a second fresh reader. Page: (1) the intro's climb now runs out into time and silence; (2) the last section "ends in" the true hallucinations; (3) beats are two oscillators that never lock; (4) masking's twin regraded to shape, cochlear swamping against lateral inhibition, table row to match; (5) interaural timing stated as tens of microseconds, a few hundredths of a millisecond; (6) Shepard: the later stages found where it breaks, the stack fuses only while every voice is an octave apart, and the 1967 film credited to Shepard and E. E. Zajac; (7) the tritone split traced by Deutsch to the speech range listeners grew up hearing; (8) streaming's mechanism marked arguable, Remez named, table row "mechanism, argued"; (9) Whisper is a cousin of phantom words, absent input against ambiguous; (10) the Risset rhythm placed on the Duality axis; (11) Stockhausen's piece is an essay, and the click-to-pitch crossing tied to [[Boundary-Crossing Instruments]]; (12) flicker fusion regraded to shape, table row to match; (13) the Zwicker tone heard by between about half and most people; (14) the twinless-rows claim marked a guess, pointing at the Context's open question 3; (15) "one wave per source" dropped from the bets; (16) "Nearly every one" can be built; (17) the masking trial is proposed for Sidechain's rich face, and the Echo Walk's Haas zone stated as the Duality states it. Context: (18, 21) Stockhausen's essay, the Shepard-Zajac film and Ungan and Yagcioglu's numbers moved to the checked list; (19) the exceptions name Hofstadter's page and dossier; (20) the visual-twin paragraph records where Shepard's Kanizsa and Rubin pairings went. Declined: a body link to Agnes Martin from the musical-ear section. Lints re-run.
